'''Chris Praskac Hunt Down at Ramapo''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Chris Praskac]] posted on DeckTech. The post says only "Hunt Down deck i played a Ramapo"; it names no date or record, so it is filed as a general deck.<ref name="dt-6716">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6716 Hunt Down at Ramapo], DeckTech (Chris "Jedi Taboos" Praskac, 14 May 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/6716/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/6716/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018171024/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/6716/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
